name: db-splice-equivalence
body: A scan's spliced `db.lbug` must equal a full rebuild of the same assembled graph on EVERY table: the per-label node counts and per-rel-type counts for the authored/transient tables (Stakeholder, User, Requirement, DomainGroup, Entity, Value, Service, System, Container, Component, Person, Constraint, Note and their spine rels; Plan, PlanPhase, Task, Feedback and their rels) exactly as for the code tables (Language, Module, File, Struct, Function, UnresolvedTarget and Contains/Calls/Uses/UnresolvedCall/UnresolvedUse). The `db.lbug` and `graph.jsonl` a single scan publishes must be projections of the same assembled graph. When the seed cannot be shown to already hold the assembled authored/transient rows, the splice must be refused and the full load (the correctness reference) must run. Never publish a DB that diverges from a rebuild. (Prose; assessed by review.)
